title: CSS shapes lit as solids
blurb: Buttons with corner-shape, border-shape and clip-path: shape() outlines, lit by a shader that reads the picture's alpha as height. Bevels and shadows follow each outline, and the light follows the pointer or the phone's tilt.
question: Are the new CSS outlines (corner-shape, border-shape, shape()) in the alpha channel of a drawn element, and is that enough for a shader to light the element as a solid?
result: Yes. Sixteen alpha samples per pixel give a usable normal, and the shadow gets the right outline. Hit testing follows all three outlines.
